overview: The committee approved a draft of the new City Council newsletter and reviewed a strategy document for hosting neighborhood ward meetings across Medford's eight wards.

items.title: City Council Newsletter
items.summary: Approved a draft of the city council newsletter summarizing activities from February through April, with instructions for the chair to rotate future drafting duties among councilors.

items.title: Neighborhood Ward Meetings Resolution
items.summary: Discussed a strategy to host at least one meeting in each of the city's eight wards over the next two years, focusing on location logistics and hybrid technology requirements. The matter remains in committee for further coordination of dates and councilor assignments.
